channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Artificial intelligence called future of farming
item.description: Farmers warned that ignoring AI technologies could leave operations at a disadvantage.

item.title: Biodiversity loss a risk to global economy, IPBES report says
item.description: Biodiversity loss is emerging as a systemic risk to the global economy and financial stability, a landmark report said on Monday, urging companies to act now or potentially face extinction themselves.

item.title: Canadians worked first 39 days of 2026 to pay for year’s grocery bill says Canadian Federation of Agriculture
item.description: Sunday marked “Food Freedom Day,” the date by which the average Canadian household earned enough money to cover its annual grocery bill as per calculations from the Canadian Federation of Agriculture.

item.title: Last year was third warmest on record
item.description: All the major reporting agencies, including NASA, NOAA, the European Copernicus program, Japan, the UK Met Office and Berkeley Earth, have ranked 2025 as either the third-warmest year on record or tied for second.

item.title: Canadian Cattle Association launches traceability survey
item.description: The Canadian Cattle Association wants producers to share their thoughts regarding the proposed traceability regulations.

item.title: Clean Fuel Regulations amendments disappoint canola sector
item.description: The canola sector is disappointed with a recent discussion paper on Clean Fuel Regulations amendments, noting that it did not include concrete provisions that will help secure additional domestic demand for canola as a biofuels feedstock.

item.title: New federal funding to open for agriculture, agri-food market diversification
item.description: A total of $75 million over five years will be available under the AgriMarketing program’s market diversification streams, federal Agriculture Minister Heath Macdonald announced in a news release on Feb. 10.

item.title: Farm Credit Canada-led coalition to invest $5 billion into agriculture innovation
item.description: FCC announces $5 billion into agriculture innovation by 2030

item.title: U.S. agriculture groups tout benefits of trade agreement
item.description: The North American trade agreement pushed U.S. agricultural exports up by $20 billion since it took effect in 2020, according to a new study from a broad coalition of American farm organizations that support renewing the deal.

item.title: Agriculture department officials address research cuts
item.description: Members of the House of Commons agriculture committee from all parties expressed concern about the recently announced cuts and closures at federal research centres as they began an emergency study on the matter Feb. 10.
